title: ZEA-REPO channels dataset
description: EarthMC server chat channels and client-side feed categories. Commands are lowercase without the leading slash.

writeChannels.description: Server channels the player can write to with commands.

messageTag.description: Exact bracket label opening that channel's chat messages, e.g. "[Local] Name: content". Absent when the channel's messages carry no leading label (global uses badges + [Nation|Town] affiliation). Must be copied verbatim from observed in-game chat.

messageTagCarriesTown.description: True when the tag is followed by the sender's town inside the bracket (nation chat: "[Nation Chat|Town]").

readonlyFeeds.description: Message categories that have no writable server command (e.g. Discord integration).
